verdict.rationale: Runway documents image-to-video generation as a core capability. Its site says it can 'generate video from text, an image or a clip,' the API exposes an image-to-video endpoint with draft previews, and Gen-4.5 is described as taking an input image, which can be passed as a URL or base64 upload. No evidence addresses how faithfully the subject and composition carry over from the still. Missing for 10: documentation or hands-on evidence that subject and composition are preserved, independent corroboration of image-to-video output quality.
